text:
Alex Chen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a agreed customer-facing flow for: statuspage wording, what we include in incident summaries, and the RCA consent/redaction ladder. Also want clear owners and timelines (what gets posted in 24/48/72h, who signs off on redactions).

Maria Gomez: +1. I can draft a compact statuspage template and a simple redaction ladder. Will post a sample in a few hours. @Jamie Liu can you confirm legal constraints? :eyes:

Jamie Liu: I can review legal edge cases this afternoon. Generally: customer-identifying info redacted by default; operational root causes ok unless PII. If we expect regulatory impact (finance/health), loop legal and security before publish.

Sujan Patel: For action tracking, let's tie every customer-facing doc to a postmortem action ID and a tracking ticket (JIRA). We should require the owner to update the ticket with the final customer note link before we close the remediation.

Maria Gomez: Draft status snippet (proposed):
```
We experienced increased request errors impacting model responses from 14:03–14:57 UTC. Root cause under investigation; mitigation applied. We will post an interim update within 2 hours and a full incident summary within 72 hours.
```

Maria Gomez: Proposed redaction ladder (simple):
- Level 0: Tech/metrics only (auto-publish)
- Level 1: Operational cause + mitigations (requires eng lead sign-off)
- Level 2: Any customer-identifying or sensitive content (requires legal + security sign-off)
- Level 3: Regulatory exposure (requires exec review)

Alex Chen: This ladder looks good. Add an explicit owner per level. Suggest owners: Level 0 = oncall, Level 1 = eng lead, Level 2 = legal + security, Level 3 = CRO/CTO.

Sujan Patel: Regarding timelines — propose: interim within 2h, 24h status note with scope, 72h provisional summary with action items, 30d closure note when all high-severity remediations complete. Owners must acknowledge in thread for SLA tracking.

Jamie Liu: Legal sign-off SLA: review within 24 business hours for Level 2 redactions. If legal needs more time, escalate to security + product for interim publish with redactions applied.

Maria Gomez: I put a short checklist in the draft: "who signs off", "redaction level", "JIRA postmortem id", "customer outreach required?" — can we require that filled before final summary goes live?

Alex Chen: Yes — require checklist fields filled. Also add a recurring pattern flag: if this incident matches a category seen 3+ times in 90 days, tag it as "recurring" and schedule a recurring incident review with infra/serving + product.

Sujan Patel: I'll add a rule to the action tracker: recurring incidents automatically create a follow-up epic and owner assignment. Also will add a column for "customer-note-published" and timestamp.

CommsBot: Statuspage draft saved to https://internal/docs/incidents/status-drafts/2560012345.html :white_check_mark:

Maria Gomez: OK I'm going to push the draft to the shared doc and tag owners for sign-off. Owners please ack here and I'll consolidate for the externals.

Alex Chen: Ack. I'll take Level 1 sign-off and ensure the postmortem action IDs are in JIRA.

Jamie Liu: Ack. I'll do Level 2 review if needed.

Sujan Patel: Ack — I'll wire up the action tracker rules and link the JIRA ticket (INF-4821).

Maria Gomez: Great — target: interim update template live within 2 hours, 72h provisional summary template and checklists merged into our postmortem playbook by EOD + owners assigned. :thumbsup:
